facts.fact: Tech Africa News reports the Konza Technopolis Development Authority signed a project preparation funding agreement with the Treasury's PPP Project Facilitation Fund for the Konza Cloud Expansion and Smart City Facilities Project, as part of ongoing efforts to develop Konza as a technology and innovation hub.
